recipes.title: Chorizo & White Bean Stuffed Roast Chicken
steps: Fry the chorizo in a little olive oil until it releases its oils. Add the onion, then the garlic and thyme leaves. Stir in the drained beans and semi-dried tomatoes and season well.
Trim off the knuckles and wingtips and season the cavity with salt and pepper.
Pack the stuffing firmly into the cavity to fill the space so it cooks evenly, then push in the whole lemon and pull the skin over to close.
Rub with olive oil, salt, pepper and paprika.
Put the chicken in a roasting tray with the wine, water and thyme sprigs. Cover tightly with foil and roast at 180°C (350°F) for 1 hour.
Remove the foil and roast another 30 minutes until the skin is golden and crisp.
Squeeze the roasted lemon into the pan juices and strain. Spoon out the stuffing, carve the chicken and pour the lemony juices over.
recipes.notes: Estimated amounts and macros; oven temperature and timings are Gordon's (180°C/350°F, 1 hour covered + 30 minutes uncovered). The stuffing keeps the chicken moist and is good enough to eat as a side on its own.
